searchStringsArray.title: Search terms
searchStringsArray.description: What to search for on Google Maps, e.g. 'dentist' or 'italian restaurant'. One term per line.

locationQuery.title: Location
locationQuery.description: Where to search, e.g. 'Chandigarh, India' or 'New York, USA'.

maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search term
maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.description: How many businesses to collect for each search term. Start small while testing.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the Google Maps results.

startUrls.title: Google Maps URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Paste specific Google Maps search or place URLs instead of using search terms.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Optional. Leave empty if you are using search terms above.

placeIds.title: Place IDs (optional)
placeIds.description: Google Place IDs, if you already have them.

googleMapsDatasetId.title: Existing Google Maps dataset ID (optional)
googleMapsDatasetId.description: If you already ran Google Maps Scraper, paste its dataset ID here to skip straight to contact enrichment.

maxPagesPerWebsite.title: Max pages to scan per website
maxPagesPerWebsite.description: Higher finds more emails but costs more and takes longer.

maxContactDepth.title: Crawl depth
maxContactDepth.description: How many clicks deep to follow links on each website. 1 is usually enough.

skipPlacesWithoutWebsite.title: Skip businesses with no website
skipPlacesWithoutWebsite.description: Businesses with no website can never have an email, so they are usually not worth keeping.

onlyPlacesWithEmail.title: Only keep results that have an email
onlyPlacesWithEmail.description: Turn on for a clean lead list. Turn off to keep every business.

googleMapsExtraInput.title: Extra Google Maps Scraper input (advanced)
googleMapsExtraInput.description: Any additional fields to pass through to the Google Maps Scraper, as JSON.
